title: Ah asghar ah asghar
body:
AAH ASGHAR AAH ASGHAR
Bano pukari ro ro kar
ah asghar Ah asghar ah asghar
Pyas who teri sidaath ki
<<DIVIDER>>
Ruk thi na thi teri hichki
Chain tujhe aye kyon kar
Chod ke kaisay jaongy
Kaise dil bailoongy
<<DIVIDER>>
Maa se lipat ja ab aakar
Jula julaoun main kisko
Lori sunaoun main kisko
Neend tujhe aye kyon kar
<<DIVIDER>>
Godi huvi suni beta
Hogaye dekho main tanha
Kab tak tadpegi madar
hai-e-vo tera nanha gala
<<DIVIDER>>
Sunthi hoon uspar teer laga
Jane kya guzri tujh par
Bhai ki furkath main
bechain Boli sakina binte hussian
<<DIVIDER>>
Nanhi se behein
Tariki hain rahoun main
Aja meri bahoun main
Tu hai mera noor-e-nazar
